title: Runtime
description: Study the implementation in [runtime.py]. Trace its declarations and dependencies into a caller or test. Inspect imports, declarations, and call sites in the file; filenames alone do not establish its role.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in runtime.py.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
